title: Goldman Sachs lifts S&P 500 year-end target to 8,000 on strong earnings outlook
title_zh: 高盛因强劲盈利前景将标普 500 指数年终目标上调至 8,000 点
summary: May 26 (Reuters) - Goldman Sachs has raised its 2026 year-end forecast for the S&P 500 index to 8,000 from 7,600, citing continued strength in corporate earnings.
summary_zh: 路透 5 月 26 日 - 高盛将标准普尔 500 指数 2026 年年底预期从 7,600 点上调至 8,000 点，理由是企业盈利持续强劲。

title: Nvidia to spend $150 billion a year in Taiwan, 'epicentre' of AI revolution, says CEO
title_zh: 英伟达首席执行官表示，每年将在人工智能革命的“中心”台湾投资 1500 亿美元
summary: Nvidia's CEO said on Wednesday the chip company plans to invest around $150 ‌billion a year in Taiwan, terming it the "epicentre" ‌of the AI revolution and predicting it will be the world's tech manufacturing ​hub for a long time.
summary_zh: Nvidia 首席执行官周三表示，该芯片公司计划每年在台湾投资约 1500 亿美元，称台湾为人工智能革命的“中心”，并预测台湾将在很长一段时间内成为世界科技制造中心。

title: Japan's Nikkei hits record high as chip-related shares jump
title_zh: 日本日经指数创历史新高，芯片相关股上涨
summary: By Junko Fujita TOKYO, May 27 (Reuters) - Japan's Nikkei share average rose to a record high on Wednesday, as gains in index heavyweight chip-related equities outweighed losses in financials and other
summary_zh: 路透东京 5 月 27 日 - 日本日经指数周三升至历史新高，因指数权重芯片相关股票的涨幅超过了金融和其他股票的跌幅。

title: Apple, Google push for judicial oversight in Canada online safety bill
title_zh: 苹果谷歌推动对加拿大在线安全法案进行司法监督
summary: By Stephen Nellis SAN FRANCISCO, May 26 (Reuters) - Apple and Alphabet's Google on Tuesday pushed to amend an online safety bill working its way through Canada's parliament to add judicial oversight
summary_zh: 路透旧金山 5 月 26 日 - 苹果和 Alphabet 旗下的谷歌周二推动加拿大议会修改一项在线安全法案，以增加司法监督

title: Meta board member Dana White says Mark Zuckerberg is like Trump, Carl Icahn, and Michael Jordan in one key way
title_zh: Meta 董事会成员达纳·怀特 (Dana White) 表示，马克·扎克伯格在一个关键方面就像特朗普、卡尔·伊坎和迈克尔·乔丹
summary: Zuck has the it factor, says UFC's top dog.
summary_zh: UFC 的头号人物表示，扎克拥有 IT 因素。

title: S&P 500, Nasdaq, hit record closing highs on AI optimism
title_zh: 标普 500 指数、纳斯达克指数因人工智能乐观情绪创下收盘新高
summary: STORY: It was a mostly upbeat Tuesday on Wall Street, despite a slight move downward for the Dow.
summary_zh: 故事：尽管道指小幅下跌，但华尔街周二表现基本乐观。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures slip amid uncertainty over US-Iran talks
title_zh: 今日股市：由于美伊谈判存在不确定性，道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克期货下跌
summary: US stock futures wavered as investors watched for updates on negotiations between the US and Iran.
summary_zh: 由于投资者关注美国和伊朗之间谈判的最新进展，美国股指期货出现波动。

title: Why the market could be in 'the most logical' bubble in history
title_zh: 为什么市场可能陷入历史上“最合乎逻辑”的泡沫
summary: As the Nasdaq Composite (^IXIC) and S&P 500 (^GSPC) are on track to close Tuesday's session at new records, the AI trade and rallies in chip stocks continue to be the biggest catalysts for markets trading at all-time highs.
summary_zh: 随着纳斯达克综合指数 (^IXIC) 和标准普尔 500 指数 (^GSPC) 有望在周二收盘创下新高，人工智能交易和芯片股的反弹仍然是市场交易创下历史新高的最大催化剂。
